title: A two-dimensional Allen-Cahn theory for interfaces with boundary
summary: We develop a two-dimensional Allen-Cahn theory for interfaces with boundary in the line-bundle framework introduced by Fröhlich and Struwe. The central new object is a model solution on the punctured plane whose nodal set is a half-line. Near the boundary of an interface, this solution plays the role of the heteroclinic profile in the classical interior theory.
